[...] The good news is that Walt Disney World has finally announced replacements for these vacant venues along the BoardWalk. Later in 2026, the new Hurly-Burly bar will open, bringing live music and light bites to the table. Also on the horizon is a new counter service restaurant concept to replace Big River, the details of which have been teased but not announced.
